RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the May 19, 2006/Vaisakha 29, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and
Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Environment and Forests; Health and Family Welfare;
Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions —20
Survey of Nasirabad-Bundi railway
line
†*501. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a provision was made in
the last budget for the survey of Nasirabad-
Bundi railway line in Rajasthan;
(b) if so, whether Government have
completed that survey; and
(c) the work proposed to be done further
by Government and the details thereof?
Ban on retail sale of bird flu drugs
*502. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that approval has
been sent to ban the retail sale of bird flu
drugs; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Medicines prescribed/disbursed by
C.G.H.S. dispensaries
*503. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) the list/names/details of the
medicines that can be prescribed/disbursed
directly by the MO/CMO of C.G.H.S.
dispensaries;
(b) the proportion of such medicines
disposed as compared to medicines
disbursed through indent procedure on
recommendation of Specialists, in terms of
their cost value (latest available figures);
(c) whether it is a fact that the activity
of diagnosis and treatment has concentrated
with the Specialists and the dispensaries
are just centers for disbursement of
medicines; and
(d) the remedial steps proposed, if any,
to restore the real utility of the dispensaries?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

156
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
National River Conservation Plan
*504. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National River
Conservation Plan is under implementation
in the country;
(b) if so, the total funds released by
Government, so far, under this plan utilized
by the concerned State-Governments;
(c) how far the scheme has been
completed most particularly the Ganga and
Yamuna Action Plan; and
(d) by when the plan is expected to be
completed?
Frame work for implementation of
NRHM
†*505. SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the feature of the National Rural
Health Mission and framework for
implementation of this scheme;
(b) the details of allocation of 8,207
crore rupees given in the budget for this
year 2006-07 item-wise;
(c) the details of role and training of the
workers 'Asha';
(d) whether Government think that this
programme would take us to success in
achieving the target of health for all; and
(e) if so, the details of the strategy to be
adopted to achieve the same?
Announcement of bonus in addition to
support price for wheat
†*506. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the support price of wheat fixed by
Government for 2006-07;
(b) whether Government have also
announced to give a bonus of Rs. 50/- per
quintal in addition to the support price;
(c) whether prices of wheat in the retail
market have gone high due to purchases
made by the MNCs and local stockists as
per announcement of the bonus of Rs. 50/
- per quintal;
(d) whether the given bonus has caused
a rise in the prices; and
(e) whether Government would succeed
in getting wheat for buffer stock after the
large scale purchase of wheat by MNCs
and local stockists?
Assistance for oil palm development
in Karnataka
*507. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have released
the amount for oil palm development during
2005 and 2006 for Karnataka;
(b) if so, the details of share of Central
and State Government; and
(c) the details of total amount released
till today?

157
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Crop diversification programme
*508. SHRI MANOHAR GAJANAN
JOSHI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a plan has been formulated
to improve soil and launch a new crop
diversification programme;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the States where it is proposed to be
launched?
Backlog vacancies
*509. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of backlog vacancies as
on 31st March 2004 in his Ministry and
various departments under his Ministry
(b) whether, special drive was carried
out to fill the above backlog vacancies;
(c) if so, the number of vacancies filled
during the last two years, department-wise;
and
(d) what is the backlog vacancies as on
31st March 2006?
New rail line from Valsad to Nasik
†*510. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) when was the final survey
conducted for construction of new railway
line from Valsad (Gujarat) to Nasik
(Maharashtra); and
(b) the provisions made for constructing
this new railway line?
Haridaspur-Paradip broad gauge line
*511. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have invited
expression of interest in the 82 kms.
Haridaspur-Paradip broad gauge rail link in
Orissa;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the action plan of
Government to expedite completion of
other on-going projects in the State to meet
the increased freight and passenger traffic
demand as a result of fast industrialization
of the State?
Underbridges at important railway
crossings
†*512. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
lakhs of people are forced to waste their
time, petrol and diesel due to closure of
barriers of railway crossings at several
places throughout the country; and
(b) whether Government propose to
have special provision in the budget for
construction of under bridges at important
railway crossings to check wastage of time,
money and labour and to facilitate
passengers in large number; if so, the details
thereof?

158
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Menace of quacks
†*513. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that many quacks are arbitrarily
treating the patients by charging them high
fees after opening their own clinics without
having the required license and proper
degree;
(b) whether treatment by such quacks
is risky for the patients' health; and
(c) if so, what action has been taken or
being taken by Government to close down
these clinics together with the details
thereof?
Poaching of leopards in Rajaji
National Park
†*514. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
illegal poaching of leopards is being done in
the country-particularly in the Rajaji
National Park causing constant decrease in
their number;
(b) if so, whether Government have
taken concrete steps to check the illegal
poaching of leopard and other wild animals;
(c) the names of categories and the
number of forest officials penalized for
illegal poaching in the National Park inspite
imposing complete ban on the poaching of
wild animals; and
(d) the number of skins of leopards
recovered from the Rajaji National Park,
during 2004-05?
Rural Backyard Poultry Development
*515. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
start a new scheme viz Rural Backyard
Poultry Development;
(b) if so, the salient features of the
scheme;
(c) the time by which the scheme is
likely to be implemented; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
strengthen the contribution of the organized
sector by promoting backyard poultry
particularly in Andhra Pradesh?
Jobs to sports person in railways
†*516. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
adopt talented sports persons by providing
jobs to them in the Railways or by giving
them training after constituting a sports
cell in view of Commonwealth Games to
be organized in 2010 in the capital;
(b) if so, the details thereof ; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Quality of wheat imported from
Australian wheat Board
†*517. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that doubts have

159
been raised about the quality of wheat when
its first consignment reached the country
after being imported from the Australian
Wheat Board;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the source which raised this
doubt?
Small Scale industries in rural
Punjab
*518. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of SMALL SCALE
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
small scale manufacturing units in the rural
areas in Punjab based on timber have been
closed down due to cheaper imports of raw
materials as well as finished goods resulting
in slump in consumption levels of farm
forestry products;
(b) whether Government have received
any request from the State Government of
Punjab to help establishment of wood
based paper mills/pulp/board industries in
Punjab and North-Western region of the
country to boost farm forestry and help
the poverty stricken families of the State;
and
(c) the action taken by Government in
the matter?
Improvement in infrastructure in
warehouses
*519. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether standard of warehouses is
poor in our country compared to other
countries;
(b) whether 30-35 per cent of foodstuff
purchased in our  country goes waste due
to poor and inadequate infrastructural
facilities in warehouses; and
(c) if so, the steps taken to provide
adequate infrastructural facilities in
warehouses?
Meningococcemia in Delhi
*520. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that national
capital has been in the grip of
Meningococcemia, the killer disease;
(b) if so, the number of suspected cases
tested positive for the disease till now by the
National Institute of Communicable Diseases;
(c) the steps taken by Government to
contain and prevent the disease spreading
in other States;
(d) whether adequate quantity of
medicines is available; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor and the
steps taken to meet the requirement thereof?

Total number of questions — 155
Farmers trained by CTRI
3641. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of farmers trained by
Central Tobacco Research Institute during
the last year;
(b) whether CTRI has given any
importance to training of farmers of Andhra
Pradesh;
(c) whether it is a fact that the CTRI
has not given sufficient importance to
extending the full benefits or research in
tobacco to middle level tobacco farmers in
Andhra Pradesh;
(d) the steps proposed by Government
to assist farmers through the CTRI in
 2006-07; and
(e) the reasons for low emphasis on this
matter?
Claim of bonus by workers of
Sugarcane Breeding Institute,
Coimbatore
3642. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN
AHAMED: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Industrial Tribunal at
Chennai had passed an award on the dispute
relating to claim of bonus by the workers
of the Sugarcane Breeding Institute at
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu;
(b) whether it is a fact that the same
award has covered the demand for
regularization in service of the workforce
of the same institute; and
(c) if so, the action initiated by
Government to implement the said award?
Increasing fertilizer consumption
3643. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the per hectare
consumption of chemical fertilizers in the
country is less than 90 kg.;
(b) the reasons for such low rate of
fertilizer consumption;
(c) the steps taken to increase fertilizer
application to increase productivity; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
promote new farming practices to increase
yield?

826
Senior official on deep-sea tuna boats
3644. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have cleared proposals to post one senior
official on every deep-sea tuna boat
operating in our waters in the EEZ;
(b) the purpose of this new rule being
considered by Government;
(c) whether Government want to give
training and experience to senior officials
involved in policy formulation;
(d) the details of such hands-on-training
being proposed;
(e) the minimum rank of officials who
will go on board for such mandatory training
on tuna boats to experience for themselves
with the realities of fishing and how to make
policy practical; and
(f) the schedule for such activity in the
next two months?
Use of pesticides and insecticides in
farming
3645. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that pesticides
and other insecticides are freely used in
vegetable farming;
(b) whether human beings and animals
consuming such vegetables face grave health
hazards;
(c) if so, the details in this regard; and
(d) the details of the measures taken/
proposed to be taken by Government to
eliminate use of pesticides in vegetable
farming?
Assistance for cultivation of Jatropha
in Chhattisgarh
3646. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Planning
Commission has approved on over
Rs. 1200 crores demonstration project for
the cultivation of Jatropha;
(b) how much amount has been
proposed to be allocated to Chhattisgarh
and how much area in this State has been in
use for Jatropha plantation; and
(c) what special incentives have been
provided to Chhattisgarh by the National
Mission on Bio-diesel?
Authority for development of rainfed
areas
3647. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA:
DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering to set up a national
authority for sustainable development of
rainfed areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government had received
any recommendations in this regard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Assistance to States for establishing
agriculture research centres
3648. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any scheme to give
financial assistance to establish State-level

827
agriculture research centres to the State
Governments;
(b) if so, the name of the scheme and its
essential features;
(c) the names of the States who have
sought financial and other assistance in this
regard; and
(d) the States to whom assistance, if
any has been granted?
Bio-diesel production
3649. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether plants/crops have been
identified in the country for bio-diesel
production;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
details of targets achieved, upto-date; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government to popularize their plantation?
Organic farming
3650. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the kind of encouragement given to
the research and spread of knowledge with
regard to organic farming;
(b) whether incentives are given to those
farmers who have taken up organic farming
as a mission; and
(c) the role of agriculture universities in
encouraging organic farming?
Popularising local seeds among
farmers of Vidarbha
3651. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the cotton
farmers of Vidarbha region of Maharashtra
are committing suicides because of
unsuitable cotton seeds which are imported;
(b) whether there is any attempt made
to give preference to the local seeds; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Throwing of onions and tomatoes by
farmers
3652. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
there are no takers for tomatoes and onions,
particularly in Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka
and Maharashtra; if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether it has been brought to his
notice that at many places in Andhra
Pradesh and Karnataka at Mysore, Kolar,
Bangalore, etc., the farmers are throwing
away tomatoes on the roads;
(c) if so, whether Government would
take this matter seriously to provide
support price and marketing facilities to
these hapless farmers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Suicides by cotton farmers
3653. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the total number of cotton growers
who have committed suicide in the country
particularly in Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka
and Maharashtra during the last three years
State-wise;
(b) whether there is gradual increase in
the number during these years;
(c) if so, causes for such a situation; and
(d) the details of measures contemplated

828
by the Union Government to save the lives
of cotton growers in the country?
Self sufficiency in the production of
bio-fertilizers
†3654. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of production of bio-
fertilizers in the country during the last
three years, company-wise;
(b) whether India has become self
sufficient in the case of bio-fertilizers; and
(c) if not, the measures being taken to
enhance production thereof?
Shifting of Small and marginal
farmers from agriculture
3655. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that small and marginal farmers
and agricultural labourers are shifting to
other professions due to indebtedness;
(b) if so, whether any survey/study has
been conducted to ascertain the reasons and
the enormity of such shifting from
agriculture; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
encourage farmers to carry on with their
farming activity?
Drought in Vidarbha
†3656. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of
Maharashtra has submitted any plan to the
Central Government to tackle the situation
of acute drought in Vidarbha region;
(b) if so, the action taken by
Government to solve the problem of
drought there; and
(c) the long term policy being formulated
by Government to deal with such situation
of frequent droughts?
Package for Second Green Revolution
3657. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the 7 point package for
Second Green Revolution that was
announced by the Hon'ble Prime Minister
recently at Hyderabad;
(b) whether any reference has been
made to promote integrated rural
development to bridge the rural-urban
divide;
(c) whether the package included five
components suggested by Dr. M.S.
Swaminathan of National Commission on
Farmers for Agricultural Renewal; and
(d) the steps proposed to be taken by
Government for improving rural
infrastructure and regulation of farm
markets?
Epidemiological study on bird flu
3658. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any epidemiological study
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

829
and surveillance has been undertaken by
Government to find out whether the
outbreak of bird flu was triggered by the
migratory birds;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is possibility of the
virus striking during the winter season again;
and
(d) if so, what preventive measures
Government propose to take in this
respect?
Assistance to Madhya Pradesh for
fishery, animal husbandry and poultry
farming
†3659. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the economic condition of
farmers having small land holdings is
pitiable;
(b) whether Government are providing
economic aid/grant to the farmers for
fishery, animal husbandry and poultry
farming, etc.; and
(c) if so, the details thereof, particularly
in the context of Madhya Pradesh?
Production of cotton, oilseeds and
pulses
3660. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
production of cotton, oilseeds and pulses
in Andhra Pradesh has come down
drastically from 2000-01;
(b) if so, the reasons for such a drastic
reduction;
(c) whether Government have made any
analysis in this regard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Containment of stray dog menace
3661. DR. M.S. GILL:
SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
due to ban on killing of stray dogs provided
in the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals
Act, the population of stray dogs in Punjab
has gone up menacingly causing threat to
public health;
(b) the steps Government have taken
under Animal Birth Control Rules for
castration of male dogs and spaying of the
females; and
(c) whether the matter has been brought
to the notice of Government by the State
Government and have asked for funds for
carrying out the ABC Programme as
required and if so, the action taken by
Government thereon?
Cold storage in Andhra Pradesh
3662. SHRI C. RAMACHANDR-
AIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
proposals from State Governments to set
up more cold storages in the States
especially in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

830
Yield of sugarcane
†3663. SHRI KANJIBHAI MAGAN-
BHAI PATEL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the provision made in 2006-07 for
increasing the yield of sugarcane; and
(b) the details of grant to be provided to
the States for this purpose?
Fishery at Hirakund
†3664. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 140 species
of fish have become extinct in the Hirakund
dam during the last ten years;
(b) if so, the action being taken by
Government in this regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that Hirakund
based Indian Fisheries Research Center,
being run by the Central Government, has
been closed down; and
(d) if so, whether any scheme has been
formulated to rehabilitate 4000 families who
are earning their livelihood with fisheries
and if so, the details thereof?
Cancellation of deep sea fishing
permits
3665. DR. M.A.M.
RAMASWAMY:
SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
have cancelled a number of deep sea fishing
permits recently;
(b) if so, the reasons for such
cancellation of permits;
(c) the details of numbers and names of
companies which have returned such letters
of permit;
(d) whether it is a fact that some
entrepreneurs have expressed serious
apprehensions with such frequent revisions
in various policies relating to fishing sector;
and
(e) if so, the steps proposed to be taken
to review the diverse revisions and changes
being thrust upon the entrepreneurs
frequently?
Production of oilseeds and pulses in
Madhya Pradesh
†3666. SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether, with a view to increase the
production of oilseeds and pulses with
Japanese assistance in the Bundelkhand
region of Madhya Pradesh, a proposal of
Rs. 108.15 crores has been sent by the
Madhya Pradesh; and
(b) by when the sanction is likely to be
accorded to the proposal?
Increase in prices of pulses
3667. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to refer to the answer to Unstarred Question
No. 1182 given in the Rajya Sabha on the
3rd March, 2006 and state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
inspite of the imports of pulses made during
2004-2005 and 2005-2006, the prices of
pulses continued to rise in the open market
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

831
during the months of January to
April, 2006;
(b) if so, the extent of increase in the
prices of various kinds of pulses during the
period; and
(c) the steps Government propose to
ensure adequate availability of pulses at
reasonable prices to the consumers before
the arrival of kharif 2006 crop of pulses in
the market?
Economic viability of Agriculture
3668. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
